newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine CIADEA ordered to pay $43.6 mln in taxes.
newsitem.headline: Argentine CIADEA ordered to pay $43.6 mln in taxes.

text.p: Argentine carmaker CIADEA, licensee of France's Renault SA, said Monday a court ordered it to pay $43.6 million in overdue value added tax.
"The amount involved is about $12.2 million in adjusted capital and $31.4 million in interest," the company told the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange.

The tax agency DGI says that between 1987-1988 CIADEA should have paid taxes based on car prices at the time of delivery rather than at the time of the sale. Prices varied dramatically due to high inflation in those years.
CIADEA, one of the biggest Argentine carmakers, said it will appeal the court ruling upholding the DGI claim.
In its first half, the firm provisioned $18.2 million for possible short-term losses and $130 million for long term ones.
